messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] A compiled version of PyStan for windows
parts:
My sense is that there are some Cython (read: Rcpp for Python) and C++ complier
challenges specific to 64-bit Windows that are not present in the 32 bit case.
The place to start seems to be:

https://github.com/cython/cython/wiki/64BitCythonExtensionsOnWindows

If anyone figures this out -- I'll help documenting it and add it to the
installation instructions.

Best,

-a
